engineeringMathematics.subject: Engineering Mathematics
engineeringMathematics.question: Rank of identity matrix I3?
engineeringMathematics.explanation: Identity matrix always has full rank = n.

engineeringMathematics.subject: Engineering Mathematics
engineeringMathematics.question: Group axioms: closure, associativity, identity, inverse. (Z,+) is:
engineeringMathematics.explanation: (Z,+) is an Abelian group: all four axioms + commutativity hold.

engineeringMathematics.subject: Engineering Mathematics
engineeringMathematics.question: LU decomposition of [[2,1],[1,2]]. L_11 = ?
engineeringMathematics.explanation: In LU decomposition without pivoting, L_11 = A_11 = 2.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Decision tree split criterion in ID3?
technical.explanation: ID3 uses Information Gain (entropy reduction). CART uses Gini index.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Linear regression minimizes:
technical.explanation: OLS minimizes sum of squared errors = MSE.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Backpropagation uses:
technical.explanation: Backprop applies chain rule to compute gradients, then gradient descent to update weights.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: K-means is:
technical.explanation: K-means is unsupervised learning (no labels).

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: PCA finds:
technical.explanation: PCA projects data onto eigenvectors of covariance matrix - directions of maximum variance.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Naive Bayes assumes:
technical.explanation: Naive = conditional independence of features given class label.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: High variance indicates:
technical.explanation: High variance = model fits training too well -> overfitting. High bias = underfitting.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Kernel trick in SVM:
technical.explanation: Kernel implicitly maps data to higher-dimensional space without explicit transformation.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Random Forest reduces:
technical.explanation: Bagging reduces variance by averaging multiple models. Bias remains similar.

technical.subject: Machine Learning
technical.question: Gradient descent with large learning rate:
technical.explanation: Too large learning rate causes overshooting -> divergence.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: RGB to Grayscale formula?
technical.explanation: Standard luminance formula weighted by human eye sensitivity.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Sobel operator detects:
technical.explanation: Sobel computes gradient magnitude -> edge detection.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Convolution layer purpose:
technical.explanation: Conv layers extract hierarchical features: edges -> textures -> patterns.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Image histogram shows:
technical.explanation: Histogram = distribution of pixel intensity values.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: YOLO architecture is:
technical.explanation: YOLO = single-stage detector. Faster R-CNN is two-stage.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Max pooling purpose:
technical.explanation: Pooling downsamples feature maps -> reduces spatial dimensions.

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Semantic vs Instance segmentation:
technical.explanation: Semantic: pixel-wise class. Instance: separate objects of same class (different colors).

technical.subject: Computer Vision
technical.question: Vision Transformer (ViT) uses:
technical.explanation: ViT splits image into patches, applies transformer self-attention.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: Tokenization is:
technical.explanation: Tokenization splits raw text into words/subwords/tokens.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: Word2Vec uses:
technical.explanation: Word2Vec uses shallow neural networks: CBOW or Skip-gram.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: Transformer self-attention computes:
technical.explanation: Attention: Q.K^T/sqrt(d) . V. Each token learns what to attend to.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: POS tagging assigns:

options.B: Part of speech to each word

technical.explanation: POS = Noun/Verb/Adjective/etc. per word.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: NER identifies:
technical.explanation: NER extracts named entities: persons, organizations, locations, dates.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: BERT is:
technical.explanation: BERT = Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Masked LM pretraining.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: Bag of Words represents text as:
technical.explanation: BoW = vector of word frequencies, ignoring order.

technical.subject: NLP
technical.question: In attention, Query comes from:
technical.explanation: Q represents the current token asking what to attend to. K,V can be from encoder or decoder.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: Symmetric key uses:
technical.explanation: Symmetric = same key for encrypt/decrypt (AES, DES).

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: RSA key generation uses:
technical.explanation: RSA: choose p,q (primes) -> n=pq -> phi(n)=(p-1)(q-1) -> choose e,d.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: Digital signature provides:
technical.explanation: Signatures verify sender (auth) and detect tampering (integrity). Not confidentiality.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: HTTPS uses:
technical.explanation: HTTPS = HTTP over TLS/SSL for encrypted communication.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: Man-in-the-middle attack:
technical.explanation: MITM attacker intercepts and may alter communication between parties.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: Firewall operates at:
technical.explanation: Firewalls can operate at network (packet filter), transport (stateful), or application (proxy) layer.

technical.subject: Information Security
technical.question: SHA-256 produces:
technical.explanation: SHA-256 produces 256-bit hash. SHA-1=160, SHA-512=512, MD5=128.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Software patent protects:
technical.explanation: Patents protect novel, non-obvious ideas/algorithms. Copyright protects expression.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Right to be forgotten relates to:
technical.explanation: Right to be forgotten = data privacy - individuals can request data removal.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Algorithmic bias means:
technical.explanation: Bias = systematic prejudice in outcomes due to biased training data or design.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: ACM Code addresses:
technical.explanation: ACM Code of Ethics covers professional conduct, responsibility, privacy, etc.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Internet censorship debate centers on:
technical.explanation: Core tension: freedom of expression vs preventing harm (hate speech, illegal content).

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Trolley problem in autonomous vehicles relates to:
technical.explanation: Trolley problem = ethical dilemma about harm minimization in unavoidable crash scenarios.

technical.subject: Ethics
technical.question: Most permissive open source license:
technical.explanation: MIT/BSD are most permissive (public domain-like). GPL is copyleft.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Full binary tree with n internal nodes has:
technical.explanation: Full binary tree: n internal -> n+1 leaves. Total nodes = 2n+1.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Inorder traversal of BST gives:
technical.explanation: Inorder of BST = elements in sorted (ascending) order.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Load factor alpha = n/m. n=50, m=25. alpha = ?

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Circular linked list last node points to:
technical.explanation: Circular LL: last.next = head. No NULL termination.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Stack insertion/removal:
technical.explanation: Stack = LIFO. Both push and pop at top (one end).

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Binary tree height h has max nodes:
technical.explanation: Perfect binary tree at height h (levels) has 2^h - 1 nodes.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Min-heap property:
technical.explanation: Min-heap: parent value <= child values.

technical.subject: Programming and Data Structures
technical.question: Queue follows:
technical.explanation: Queue = FIFO (First In First Out).

technical.subject: Algorithms
technical.question: Topological sort requires:
technical.explanation: Topological sort only defined for DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph).

technical.subject: Algorithms
technical.question: 0/1 Knapsack is solved by:
technical.explanation: 0/1 Knapsack is classic DP. Greedy works for fractional but not 0/1.
